contract.persistentScope: Full SHA-256 base64url digest of version/adminId/uid/touristUid/checkout key/form ID in attachments/ao/<digest>/<random UUID without hyphens>.<extension>; maximum 96 ASCII bytes in name(100)
contract.admission: Unexpired checkout, uncreated order key, exact live actor/buyer/cart ownership and one active product-selected form containing an upload component
contract.transactions: Initial bounded READ ONLY REPEATABLE READ SQL scope check; R2 put outside SQL transaction; metadata transaction repeats checks and pins cart/product/form with FOR SHARE NOWAIT
contract.failure: Definite pre-write or SQL rejection compensates the R2 object; failed direct cleanup queues the exact key. Unknown metadata commit outcome retains objects. SQLSTATE 40003 is explicitly unknown, not a generic class-40 rollback.
contract.multipart: Existing 10 MiB image / 10.25 MiB multipart bounds and content/MIME validation retained; duplicate file/filename file parts no longer silently select the first
